plan.title: The Gala Offer
plan.turn: Melissa tells Justin he must choose between the gala tomorrow night and their tavern partnership, and demands his answer now.

needs.text: Justin has dreamed of playing a real stage for years
Melissa and Justin built the tavern together and it is their shared dream
Ruby knows Melissa once tried to send Justin on tour two years ago without telling her

infos.text: Justin has wanted to perform on a real stage in front of important people for five years, because he dreams of being heard beyond the tavern walls
Melissa and Justin built the tavern together and share the dream of making it the place where famous musicians play
Two years ago, Melissa tried to book Justin for a tour she later cancelled, and neither Melissa nor Justin told Ruby about it
The merchant's gala tomorrow night is a real stage with people who matter attending
Melissa believes the gala is Justin's only chance at a real stage and is worth sacrificing the tavern show
Ruby believes that choosing the gala means choosing ambition over the people who believed in him first

beats.what: Melissa raises a glass to toast the tavern's first anniversary; Ruby counts the empty bottles on the bar and mutters about inventory; Melissa: 'To a thousand more nights.' Ruby: 'If we survive the month.'
Justin admits to both of them: 'I love playing here. I hate that I'm still playing here.' He looks between them, waiting for a reaction.

Melissa leans forward and squeezes Justin's shoulder. Ruby watches from the bar, her jaw tightening; Melissa: 'You're going to play bigger stages.' Ruby turns away to stack glasses louder than necessary.
Melissa tells Justin: 'Remember when we couldn't afford the lights? You said 'Someday people will come here to hear you, not just drink cheap wine.' I remember. I built this place for that day.'

Ruby approaches Justin and asks: 'You never even told me Melissa tried to send you on tour two years ago.' Melissa cuts in: 'I told him to keep it from you. It fell through anyway.' Ruby's eyes don't leave Melissa.
Justin starts to speak to Ruby: 'It was complicated, I wanted to—' but Melissa touches his arm and he stops.
Melissa says to both of them, looking only at Ruby: 'Some people get offered things they don't deserve. The question is whether their friends let them throw it away.' She steps closer to Justin.
Ruby's voice drops as she speaks to Justin: 'If you walk out that door with her tomorrow night, I'm not sure I can stay. I'm not sure I can watch you become someone I don't recognize.'

beats.tech: Menace : si tu X, je Y
beats.what: Melissa faces Justin: 'Tomorrow night, you walk on that stage or you stop calling yourself a musician. If you say no to me, I'm out of this tavern and out of your life.'
Justin looks between Melissa and Ruby. One hand is on the bar; the other is reaching toward Melissa. He must tell them both what he is choosing, and live with what comes next.
opts: Tell Melissa yes. Perform at the gala. Leave the tavern tomorrow night.
Tell Melissa no. Stay at the tavern. Promise Ruby you will never lie to her again.

beats.what: Justin turns to Melissa and says: 'I want this. I want the stage. I want people to hear me beyond these walls.' Melissa hugs him. Ruby watches from the bar, sets down her drink, and walks toward the door without a word.
Melissa and Justin stand together in the tavern; Melissa pulls out a notebook and starts planning the gala set. The lights stay on. The room is quiet.

Justin turns to Melissa: 'I can't. Not like this. Not at the cost of everything we built.' Melissa's face hardens. She walks to a corner table and sits alone, ordering a drink. Ruby's hand finds Justin's, but her eyes stay on Melissa, afraid.
Justin tells Melissa he has convinced her to let him do both: play the gala and stay loyal to the tavern. Melissa's eyes narrow.

The gala organizer arrives at the tavern to confirm Justin's attendance and find him working behind the bar. Ruby hears everything. She stands and says: 'You lied to me. Again.' The door closes behind her.

chars.name: Melissa
traits: protective of what she built with Justin

chars.name: Ruby
traits: loyal to Justin, fears losing him
remembers what was hidden from her
